visualCharacteristics.purpose: Placeholder panel for an interactive arcade game, linking to the playable game on tobysuch.uk

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = game key/name (e.g. chess, countdown-numbers); row 2 (optional) = short description; row 3 = link to play the game on the original site (e.g. https://www.tobysuch.uk/arcade/chess/). Optional label cells (game | ..., description | ...) are accepted

usage: Exactly one per arcade game page (/arcade/<game>/). Renders a centred dark panel: "Coming soon", game name, description and a "Play <Game> on tobysuch.uk" button.
reuseGuidance: Use for every arcade game page. Do not re-implement game UI (buttons, tiles, sliders, grids); those catalog variants are folded into this placeholder.
